name: lodestar
description: Lodestar — your compass for open questions: capture them, prioritize them, and never lose one. SQLite-backed so nothing is lost.

scripts.test-brain: BOARD_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 uv run --project brain uvicorn lodestar_brain.server:app --port 8001
scripts.test:all: node scripts/backup-db.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.js && uv run --project brain pytest brain/tests -v && uv run --with playwright python tests/e2e_test.py
